main_text.p: ris, quifquis in hoc opufculum inci-deris. Ob chartæ difficultatem, per quam prœla multa quiefcunt, coac-tus fum in duas partes id diftribuere, utque priorem folum hoc tempore exhibeo, ita posterior Theologiæ non minus, quam Jurisprudentiæ, & Medicinæ, nec non Practicæ Philosophiæ, comparandæ cum Theologia & Jurisprudentia, certitudinem contra quoscunque aftruet: &, quoniam hoc seculo longe maxima seges est Semi-Scepticorum, [licet haut difficitendum sit, quosdam per calumniam iisdem accenferi] in eorum qua molimina, qua axiomata libro sexto ubertim inquiram. Accipies vero, Lector, hanc posteriorem partem propediem, modo typographi diligentia non hebescat, circa ea, quæ paucarum solûm hebdomadarum impendium efflagitant. Interea vale, atque conatibus meis fave. Groningæ Non. Septemb.

page.notes: Running head and catchword "In" transcribed as printed; the catchword "In" is at the right of the foot line. Some words are uncertain in the scan: "haut difficitendum" and "calumniam" may be misprinted but are copied as seen. Specks and digitiser marks omitted.
